What began with an invitation has grown into more than 50,000 firsthand stories of China.
Since the launch of the "50,000 in 5 Years" Initiative in November 2023, over 50,000 young Americans have crossed the Pacific to study, explore and connect with Chinese people face to face,

Thirty-three journalists from 30 countries and regions visited Chongqing to explore hillside commercial spaces and an air-raid shelter-turned-teahouse. The group praised China's ingenuity, people-focused approach, and blend of tradition and modernity. https://t.co/xKoVgLpAKb

A wind turbine blade gets maneuvered through tight bends by a special transport vehicle. At about 100 meters in length, the giant blade must be lifted and rotated to clear obstacles. #WindPower #Engineering #China https://t.co/XK95Zibtji
